== Missing data ==
Encyclopedia 2.0 names Decipher employee promotional appearances, the Scrye #18 insert, mail-away requests, and the First Anthology as how players received a pack. Encyclopedia 3.2 names the Scrye #18 insert and the First Anthology. The sealed bag is printed "FREE JEDI PACK" and "ONE PER CUSTOMER... PLEASE". The bag also prints "ALL JEDI PACKS CONTAIN THE SAME 11 COMMON CARDS"; the card list uses Premium.

Wookieepedia and hobby listings add a SASE shipping fee. That wording is not dested. CardGuide's 10-card count is not dested.
